sections.title: Horizon, live

sections.title: About Horizon
sections.intro: Horizon is a fighter jet's head-up display: the readings slide past on tapes, the big value sits boxed between them, and a strip shows the time, all green on black.

items.alt: The Horizon style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Horizon, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Horizon once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Horizon's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.
